subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should Android `system.notify` support tap deeplinks, and if yes should those targets share the broader allowlisted Android URL-launch policy or be limited to OpenClaw-owned routes?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but choosing a safe target policy changes a native Android app-launch boundary and may add a new allowlist/config surface.

options.title: Share one allowlisted deeplink policy
options.body: Define one Android URL/deeplink allowlist and let both a future open-url command and notification contentIntent use that policy.

options.title: Restrict to OpenClaw routes only
options.body: Allow notification taps only to open OpenClaw-owned app routes or in-app action screens, leaving arbitrary companion-app deeplinks out of `system.notify`.

options.title: Keep notification taps passive
options.body: Leave `system.notify` without deeplinks and pursue local app launch only through the separate allowlisted command discussion.

recommendation.title: Share one allowlisted deeplink policy
recommendation.body: Define one Android URL/deeplink allowlist and let both a future open-url command and notification contentIntent use that policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and recent blamed contributor on the Android notification handler, so he is the best available owner for this policy choice.
